# `collab/CollabPlaySync.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabPlaySync.js`

CollabPlaySync.js Synchronizes play/pause/stop across all connected peers. Broadcasts a shared determinism seed so all simulations run identically. Sends heartbeat hashes every 1s for divergence detection.

### `broadcastPlay(playSync, seed)`

Broadcast a play command to all peers. Called when local user hits Play. seed: optional 32-bit int. Generated here if not provided.

### `broadcastPause(playSync)`

Broadcast a pause command to all peers.

### `broadcastStop(playSync)`

Broadcast a stop command to all peers.

### `onRemotePlayCommand(playSync, op)`

Handle an incoming play_sync op from a remote peer. Returns the action taken: 'play' | 'pause' | 'stop' | null

### `onRemoteHeartbeat(playSync, op)`

Handle an incoming sim_heartbeat op from a remote peer.

### `exportTimeline(editor, filename)`

### `isRemotePlay(playSync)`
